**Visual Analysis of Test Image:**
- Soybean trifoliate leaf with scattered irregular brown/tan lesions
- Some lesions appear angular (bounded by leaf veins)
- Yellow halos surrounding several lesion clusters
- Papery/tan texture on lesion centers
- Lesions scattered across multiple leaflets, some coalescing

**Key features pointing to Bacterial Blight:**
- Angular lesions bounded by veins - classic bacterial blight hallmark
- Water-soaked to tan/brown lesion centers
- Yellow chlorotic halos around lesions
- Scattered distribution across the leaf surface
- Pattern matches reference images (bottom panels especially) showing discrete to coalescing angular spots with yellow halos on otherwise green leaves
